source_semantics.TRADE_VALUE_1M: RAW_Aux2; IDR transaction value per eligible historical stock transaction bar
source_semantics.NBSS_VALUE_1M: RAW_OpenInterest physical slot in validated historical source; signed one-minute transaction-value imbalance; availability guard mandatory
source_semantics.FLOW_MECHANISM_SCOPE: eligible continuous regular stock transaction bars only; do not interpret unavailable/unproven zero as neutral

candidate_families.handbook_basis: Aggressive-buy effort without corresponding price/high progress may indicate ineffective buying, maturity or supply absorption; positive NBSS/HAKA alone is insufficient.
candidate_families.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN when NBSS/HAKA/HAKI availability or mechanism eligibility is not proven

candidate_families.handbook_basis: Sell pressure is constructive only as an effort-to-result relation: selling appears while proportional price damage/new-low development is absent; stronger variants may require acceptance/recovery and renewed highs.
candidate_families.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN when flow availability is unproven; strict acceptance variant is UNKNOWN when canonical VWAP input is unavailable

candidate_families.handbook_basis: High renewal/age is a behavior dimension: incremental fresh highs differ from a high that stopped developing earlier.
candidate_families.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN until enough prior observed bars exist for the selected causal lookback

candidate_families.handbook_basis: Strength established earlier and retained through pressure is different from a weak/flat path that only becomes strong through late lift/chase.
candidate_families.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN before configured early checkpoint or when session identity is unavailable

candidate_families.handbook_basis: Prior weakness/FAKE does not automatically imply failure; recovery can show low stabilization, reclaim/acceptance, renewed high development and activation.
candidate_families.unknown_rule: VWAP-specific variant is UNKNOWN rather than substituted when canonical VWAP is unavailable

candidate_families.handbook_basis: Runner/failure separation often becomes more visible around H-2 and strengthens into H-1; recurring sequence includes progressive improvement, H-1 activation/range expansion, renewed/fresh high development and pressure that fails to destroy acceptance.
candidate_families.causal_clock: Uses completed H-2 and H-1 only when applied to current H; never current-day future data.
candidate_families.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN when either completed prior session is unavailable

testing_contract.promotion_rule: No candidate becomes canonical solely because backtest profit or hit-rate is high.
